method.class: Single-run reliability diagnostic for stochastic Kernel SHAP on tabular classifiers
method.description: The evaluator owns datasets, model training (logistic regression, random forest, sklearn MLP), an interventional Kernel SHAP sampler with a fixed 32-row background and a coalition budget of 4*d or 16*d per run, and the label: the mean top-3 Jaccard agreement between the assessed run and 8 independent evaluator-run reruns. The candidate receives ONE assessed run per explained instance (bit-packed coalition masks, regression weights, evaluator-computed coalition values, anchors) through handle(diagnose) and returns r_hat in [0,1] predicting that agreement. Scored by squared error against labels, always-reliable (1.0), constant 0.5 and split-half-gap baselines and a label-permuted-pairing control (20 deterministic derangements). Bounded claim only: Kernel SHAP, 3 model families, the declared datasets, budgets, k=3, background 32; no deep tabular models or other explainers.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility = search correct == true (integrity, transcript, well-formed responses, non-vacuous controls, wall clock) and finite combined_score; no comparative threshold is imposed on search. Eligible candidates are ranked by combined_score descending, exact ties to the earlier-evaluated candidate; the top eligible candidate is frozen before any final resource or seed is used. Final correct certifies only integrity/validity of the sealed measurement; the final claim assessment (diagnostic informative only if the three skill_* bootstrap lower bounds are positive and combined_score exceeds control_permuted_score by a positive lower bound) is reported separately and never feeds back into search selection.

required_evidence: Actual SHA-256 of task.md and of every snapshotted dataset file, plus pinned package versions and the folktables full commit SHA, declared in contract provenance; data acquisition date, ACS survey year and state, subsampling rule.

Normalized content-hash disjointness report between all search and all final records (and their intersection count of zero), the German Credit partition rule, de-duplication counts, seeds disjointness, and the split manifest.

Preflight record of the largest representative production request and response serialized as UTF-8 JSON (bytes with base64 expansion, envelope and framing), shown strictly below 64 MiB, plus the actual RPC call counts against max_candidate_rpc_calls caps (search 50, final 74) and the observed reset transcripts equal to the declared search/final sequences.

Smoke logs for both planes from the same code paths with reduced workload only, plus wall-clock calibration used to confirm that the full production budgets fit; explicit statement that smoke does not attest the production workload and that no production result is claimed before the real runs complete.

Search and final metrics.json (exact scalar sets), the declared aggregation hierarchy with weights, the plane-level mean rerun-agreement label (mean top-3 Jaccard) at the 4*d and 16*d budgets (mean_label_low_budget, mean_label_high_budget), and the conditions under which single-run Kernel SHAP is reliable, conditional or unreliable at that plane/budget level, reported as measured including negative and uncertain results; no per-dataset/model tables and no RBO or Nogueira stability are produced by the evaluators.

Comparisons of the candidate diagnostic with always_reliable, constant_half and split_half_gap_heuristic baselines (positive skill means lower MSE) with paired-bootstrap intervals, and the label_permuted_pairing control with confirmation that derangements were non-vacuous; incomplete or failed cases/controls reported with their worst-case contributions and never omitted or renormalized.

Statement of the enforcement distinction: the Kernel SHAP coalition budget per run is enforced by the trusted evaluator (the evaluator generates and counts coalitions), the wall-clock deadline and broker RPC cap are harness-enforced, and the candidate has no internal-operation counter that is trusted; candidate-reported counters, if any, are advisory only.

Frozen-candidate evidence: search ranking record of all evaluated candidates (at most 3 cycles x 1 evaluation), eligibility status, the deterministic selection and tie rule applied, and proof the candidate was unchanged at final time; explicit separation of scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim assessment.

Limitations statement: explainer variability considered only from coalition sampling (fixed 32-row background per cell, fixed trained model per episode), only 3 model families, 2 seeds per plane, k=3, interventional (not conditional) expectations, Kernel SHAP only, and any dataset substitution made at scaffold time; no deep tabular architectures or GPU experiments.
